g.text: Later pilots do not establish a replacement for original M4
Figure S2 | Exploratory follow-ups shown as separate cohorts; no pooled success rate
Continuation: mixed fixed8 loses two vs H8, failing preservation. Adapter: p95 exceeds the frozen 2× ceiling; remaining repeats stay unrun.
Fresh H8: 22 vs 24 targeted successes; 29 vs 29 clean. Targeted contains 24 base tasks; plotted intervals retain the task-cluster sensitivity analysis.
Fresh rollouts use previously evaluated task pools and one training seed. Case-specific gains do not establish general improvement, inferiority or equivalence.
